title: Strawberry Lace discharges fierce groove with new single 'When the Dog Bites'
htmlContent:
Strawberry Lace is stepping up with their new single, "When the Dog Bites." This energetic track combines catchy funk-rock vibes with a bit of gritty alt-rock edge, showcasing the band's impressive skills while keeping the excitement levels high.

The drums lock in perfectly, giving the song a strong backbone. The electric guitars take over with two impressive solos that add flair without overwhelming the song. These moments of musical excitement show how Strawberry Lace skillfully balances chaos and control.

https://open.spotify.com/album/4Pi7sXybr2qGVNvluXz5xd?si=_2L5ZPSQR8Cw-yleJveOww

The band's chemistry is evident, with each member feeding off the other's energy to create a sound that's both polished and wild. Strawberry Lace delivers a track that can light up a stage just as easily as it can get stuck in your head. It's a loud, unforgettable statement and impossible to ignore.
